ServiceBus.//: Real Azure Service Bus Standard namespace (topics require Standard - Basic is queues-only). FullyQualifiedNamespace set means the client authenticates with DefaultAzureCredential rather than a key - locally that resolves to your own `az login` session (AzureCliCredential), in the deployed API it would resolve to the user-assigned managed identity, same pattern as the Azure SQL connection. ConnectionString is intentionally empty: no key exists for this namespace to leak.

Database.//: Shared by every worker instance on purpose - the idempotency ledger only arbitrates between competing consumers if they are all looking at the same table. Default Timeout gives Microsoft.Data.Sqlite a 30s window to retry SQLITE_BUSY rather than throwing the moment two instances write at once.
